key_insight: FEVessel learns a mesh-independent 3D pressure-vessel solver without FEM labels by pretraining on total potential energy, then uses its prediction to accelerate iterative FEM solves.
engineering_relevance: It enables fast, robust stress/displacement analysis across varying materials, geometries, loads, and even degenerate meshes where standard FEM becomes unreliable or fails.
method: Represents each vessel as a point cloud with coordinate, material, and load channels.
Pretrains a Transolver operator on total potential energy instead of supervised FEM displacement labels.
Uses the learned prediction as a warm start for algebraic multigrid solving.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 1.35% relative displacement error, 2.07% strain error, a 9.2× wall-clock speedup, and below-3.66% error on inverted/sliver meshes.
watch_item: Performance and speedup may depend on the quality of point-cloud sampling and solver setup, so deployment still needs careful mesh and tolerance choices.
paper_title: FEVessel: Mesh-Independent Analysis of 3D Pressure Vessels with the Label-Free Pretrained Finite Element Method
